text:
Avery Lee: Heads-up: we're sunsetting the legacy `X-API-Key` header for public SDK auth in favor of short-lived bearer sessions (RW_SESSION_TOKEN). This affects hosted API usage and SDKs; docs and migration guide are live.

Kiran Das: TL;DR: SDKs will emit a deprecation warning when `X-API-Key` is used in v4.5; v5 will reject with 401 and an advice header `X-Auth-Upgrade: Bearer`.

Maya Chen: Docs note: added migration checklist and code snippets. Quick JS snippet to mint token via CLI: `rwctl auth mint --ttl 3600 > /tmp/token && export RW_SESSION_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/token)`

QA-Lead: QA plan: add tests for both header and bearer paths, ensure telemetry and rate limits behave the same.

docs-bot: Migration guide: https://intranet.redwood/docs/auth-migration-legacy-key-to-session (internal). Sample server config for Private deployments included.

CS-Team: We'll notify customers with high usage and any enterprise accounts that manage keys centrally. Draft customer email ready.

release-bot: rolling out sdk/v4.5.0-rc1 to canary (region-eu-west-1) build 450-rc. Monitor: auth_deprecation_warnings, auth_failures_post_migration.

Avery Lee: Action items: 1) Docs: publish banners on quickstarts. 2) SDK: warn+helpful error header. 3) CS: notify flagged accounts. 4) Ops: ensure private deploys can enable `auth.legacy_accept = true` for two release cycles. React :eyes: when you reviewed the migration guide.
